blocks.text: LABRADOR, Pangasinan — A community coalition in Labrador, Pangasinan, has asked a House technical working group to exclude their coastal town from proposed nuclear energy investments, citing threats to livelihoods and the risk of radioactive waste pollution. The request from Talindeg Pangasinan (TaPang) came in a formal opposition letter dated Oct. 14 addressed to the technical working group of the House Special Committee on Nuclear Energy. The group is pushing House Bill No. 8567, which provides incentives for integrating nuclear energy into the Philippine electricity grid. The committee is chaired by Pangasinan Second District Rep.
